_comment: Shot list for episode 2. Each shot starts at the section id in 'from' and holds until the next. 'image' is the file under audio/shots/images/<episode folder>/ (missing files fall back to a title card with 'card' text). Shared images (scroll, Brian's pew) are reused from episode 1. 'prompt' is for the image model; 'description' is the written description for blind viewers and the episode notes.
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, warm spring morning light, first-century Jericho: a palm town in a hot valley with dry hills behind. No faces shown close up; figures seen from behind or at a distance. No text in the image. No modern objects. 16:9.

shots.prompt: A man in a ragged cloak sitting in the dust at the side of a wide dirt road at the edge of a palm town, seen from behind and a little above, the road empty for now, dry hills in the distance, early morning light.
shots.description: A man in a ragged cloak sits in the dust beside an empty dirt road at the edge of a palm town, hills beyond.

shots.card:
Not By Sight
Episode 2: Bartimaeus at Jericho
shots.prompt: Title card background only: the oasis town of Jericho seen from the hills at sunrise, date palms and green groves in a brown valley, no people, no text, lower third calm.
shots.description: Title card over Jericho at sunrise, palms in a brown valley: Not By Sight, episode two, Bartimaeus at Jericho.

shots.card: Spring, a few days before Passover
shots.prompt: A long line of pilgrims in robes walking a dirt road between date palms toward distant hills, families, mule carts and a few priests, seen from behind, warm morning light.
shots.description: A long line of pilgrims with mule carts walks a dirt road between palms toward the hills.
The open scroll in warm light. The Scripture reader begins.

shots.card: What do you want Me to do for you?
shots.prompt: Two men in travelling robes walking close on either side of a third man on a dusty road, leaning in to speak to him, all three seen from behind, a crowd following further back, bright dry light.
shots.description: Two disciples lean in to speak to Jesus as they walk, seen from behind, the crowd behind them.
The open scroll again. Mark's account.

shots.prompt: The plain of Jericho in the Jordan Valley: groves of date palms and low balsam shrubs, a spring-fed stream, a few flat-roofed houses and a palace wall, the bare brown hills of the climb to Jerusalem rising behind, no people.
shots.description: The green plain of Jericho, palms and balsam groves and a palace wall, with bare brown hills rising behind.

shots.prompt: A seated beggar at the roadside with his head turned toward the sound of a crowd coming down the road in the distance, a cart with a mule nearby, sheep in a field to one side, seen from behind the beggar, dust in the morning light.
shots.description: An imagined scene. A seated beggar turns his head toward a crowd coming down the road, a mule cart near, sheep in a field.

shots.prompt: A large crowd on a dirt road standing completely still, all turned toward one figure at their centre who has stopped, seen from above and behind, a beggar rising from the roadside at the edge of the frame, palms and bright light.
shots.description: The whole crowd stands still, turned toward one figure at its centre; at the edge a beggar begins to rise.

shots.prompt: A worn cloak lying in the dust at the roadside with a few coins spilled on it, bare footprints leading away from it toward a crowd, no people in the near frame, morning light.
shots.description: A worn cloak lies in the dust with coins spilled on it, bare footprints leading away toward the crowd.
The white cane leaning against a church pew. Brian speaks.
The open scroll. Luke's account.

shots.prompt: Ancient ruined mound of an old city near a spring on one side, and across a short stretch of palms a newer town with Herodian palace walls and gardens on the other, a road running between them, no people, wide view, warm light.
shots.description: A wide view: the ruined mound of old Jericho by a spring, and across the palms the newer town's palace walls, a road between.

shots.prompt: A broad low-branched sycamore fig tree beside a town street, a small man in a fine robe perched in its branches seen from behind, a crowd passing below, dappled light.
shots.description: A small man in a fine robe perches in a broad, low-branched sycamore fig above a passing crowd.

shots.prompt: A town street in Jericho with palms: in the foreground a man walking with a shorter man in a fine robe toward a doorway, and further back along the road a man in a plain robe following in the crowd, all seen from behind, warm midday light.
shots.description: Jesus walks with the short tax collector toward a doorway; further back the healed beggar follows in the crowd.
The white cane and the pew again. Brian speaks.
The open scroll. Matthew's account.

shots.prompt: Two men seated side by side at a roadside under a palm, one with a hand raised toward a passing crowd, seen from behind and a little to the side so no faces show, bright dry light.
shots.description: Two men sit side by side under a palm at the roadside, one hand raised toward the passing crowd.
The white cane and the pew. Brian speaks.

shots.prompt: A dirt road climbing out of a green valley into steep bare brown hills under a wide sky, a crowd of small figures walking up it seen from far behind, one figure near the back walking freely with no stick or guide, afternoon light.
shots.description: A road climbs from the green valley into bare brown hills; a crowd of small figures walks up it, one near the back walking freely.

shots.card:
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
2 Corinthians 5:7

1eyebiney.github.io/blindness-in-the-Bible
shots.prompt: Jericho's palms at dusk seen from the road above the valley, the first lamps lit in the town, deep blue sky, no people, no text, lower third calm and dark.
shots.description: Closing card over Jericho's palms at dusk, lamps lit in the town: For we walk by faith, not by sight. The site address.
